Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家。孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了。在那个城市，孟母从早到晚都找工作，可是找不到，害得孟母没有钱。难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房。他们搬了到别一个城市找工作。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家：在古代，better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears；住在靠近墓地的地方/墓地附近，delete了，在+Place
- 孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了：孟子，孩子is vague and unclear
- 难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房：wrong information, 搬家因为孟母觉得it is not good to imitate how to offer sacrifices
- 他们搬了到别一个城市找工作：搬到了，另外一个城市，“别（的）” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，古代 already names a time period, so adding 的时候 is redundant; use 在古代 for this historical setting. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 住了在：住在，住 describes the family’s setting/state here rather than a completed action, so it does not take 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 跟孩子搬家：带着孩子搬家，跟 means “together with,” while a mother moving a young child to a new place should use 带着. [vocab list]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 搬了到：搬到了，when 到 is the resultative/directional complement of 搬, 了 follows the complement rather than coming between the verb and 到. [teacher rule: le_placement]
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别一个城市：另一个城市，别 cannot modify a classifier phrase to mean “another”; 另一个 correctly refers to a different city. [rule: none]
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 在那个城市：在他们住的城市里，那个 suggests that the city has already been identified, but no city has appeared yet; introduce it with a full noun phrase that connects it to the family. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
7. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 害得孟母没有钱：害得她没有钱，孟母 was the subject in the same sentence, so a pronoun is more natural for a close re-occurrence with no competing female character. [rule: redundancy_delete]
8. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 每天在墓地祭拜了：每天在墓地祭拜，每天 marks a routine, so use the zero particle rather than 了, which marks a completed action. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: 古代已经表示时间段，古代的时候重复；在古代正确。
住在表示居住状态，不能说住了在，改为住在正确。
跟孩子搬家可以表示母亲和孩子一起搬家，并非必须改成带着孩子搬家。
到是搬的趋向补语，完成体了应放在补语后面，搬到了正确。
别一个城市不能表示“another city”，另一个城市是正确说法。
城市尚未被介绍，那个城市的指代没有明确先行内容。
孟母刚作本句主语且没有竞争指代对象，此处用她更符合近距离回指规则。
每天表示习惯性动作，此处不应使用表示完成的了。
